about: Signed server descriptors (topiaforge.server-descriptor/1). Every runtime that signs or checks one replays these: C# (provider), Dart (launcher) and TypeScript (control plane). Generated by an independent Python and OpenSSL implementation; Ed25519 signatures are deterministic, so signing a valid case's descriptor with its key must reproduce signedBytes exactly.

valid.about: A public session with three packages, one of each role.
Escapes, non-ASCII text, null targets, the largest session and a host that serves packages.
An empty package list still has a digest: the SHA-256 of [].
